en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a gently sloping street lined with 2–3 story historic houses with steep red roofs and light facades. A fence and large trees border the left side of the street, and a wooden fence and shrubbery appear on the right. A few pedestrians and a horse‑drawn vehicle are visible in the distance. The sky is softly tinted blue and orange. The caption at the top reads "Wesenberg - Rakwere."
